_readme: One reward track per character, levels 2-100 (RewardTrack.StartingLevel/MaxLevel), edit this file then run Prince's Palace > Build Default Content. EVERY TRACK SHARES THE SAME TWELVE MILESTONE LEVELS -- 10, 20, 25, 30, 40, 45, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90, 100 -- and a track's milestones array must carry exactly one entry per level, naming no other. The remaining 87 levels are FILLER, authored as a MIX of (reward, amount, count) rows rather than as levels: the counts across a track's filler array must sum to exactly 87, and where each one lands is computed (docs/PLAN_REWARD_TRACKS.md §4, 'where a filler node actually lands'), not authored. FILLER MAY ONLY BE A GRANT (a quantity accumulated on the save, e.g. StatPoint, MaxHealth) -- a one-shot capability (Respec, SecondLife, and once authored, SignatureAbsorbs/UnlockSkill) is refused as filler and belongs on a milestone instead. reward is a TrackReward enum member name, matched case-insensitively; against is a DamageType name, read only by rewards typed to one element; skillId is read only by UnlockSkill and must name a skill authored to the same character. This file ships with an EMPTY tracks array -- docs/PLAN_REWARD_TRACKS.md's P2 lands the content type and its validation in isolation; P6 authors Shawn's and Odette's real tracks once P3/P4 make something read them. Field-by-field documentation, defaults and valid enum values: docs/CONTENT_SCHEMA.md.
